title: Find the name and type of the card with the highest converted mana cost amo
question: Find the name and type of the card with the highest converted mana cost among all cards in sets that belong to either the 'Masques' or 'Mirage' block and are available in paper format.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_071"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
WHERE T2."XCL_097" IN ('Masques', 'Mirage')
  AND T1."XCL_004" LIKE '%paper%'
ORDER BY T1."XCL_011" DESC
LIMIT 1
